_note: Key: moon_phase. 8 blocks. ~20 words. One sentence. Poetic. No variables inside block.
fallback: Let the day stay honest enough to reveal its next workable shape.
new_moon: Let the beginning remain quiet enough for its true shape to gather.
waxing_crescent: Let the small signal receive enough care to become a usable direction.
first_quarter: Let the pressure clarify what deserves movement and what needs restraint.
waxing_gibbous: Let refinement become devotion to what is almost ready to live.
full_moon: Let what is illuminated be met with steadiness, not performance.
waning_gibbous: Let the meaning be shared only after it has become clear enough to carry.
last_quarter: Let release make room for the form that can actually continue.
balsamic: Let the ending soften what no longer needs to be held in place.
